response.answer:
Lesson 02

प्रोडक्ट शीट को reference में लगाएँ और “keep exactly the same, same text and logo” लिखें। छोटा टेक्स्ट AI की सीमा है। 2–3 परिणाम बनाकर सबसे साफ़ चुनें; अक्षरों के हमेशा सही होने की गारंटी नहीं है।

result.excerpts:
[S1] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Label ke akshar / keys ke letters (course-material) [Lesson 02; lesson_2]
Label ke akshar / keys ke letters Product sheet reference lagao, pehli line "keep exactly the same, badal gaye same text and logo". Chhota text AI ki limitation hai — 2–3 versions banao, best chuno. (L02)
Reviewed English translation: Use the product sheet reference and start with “keep exactly the same, same text and logo”. Small text is an AI limitation. Generate 2–3 versions and choose the clearest; perfect lettering is not guaranteed.

[S2] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Video mein letters blur (course-material) [Lesson 06; lesson_6]
Video mein letters blur Movement mein chhota text bigad sakta hai. Dheema movement, 2–3 baar banao. (L06)
Reviewed English translation: Small text can blur during movement: this is an AI limitation. Use one slow movement, generate 2–3 versions and choose the clearest. A perfect result is not guaranteed.

[S3] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Product sheet banana (course-material) [Lesson 02; lesson_2]
• Phone se product ki 5–7 photos, alag angles, din ki roshni, flash off, details saaf. • Google Flow → New project → Image → Nano Banana Pro. • Saari photos upload/reference mein lagao → product sheet prompt chalao. • Sheet achhi na aaye toh dobara generate karo. Achhi sheet ko save rakho — poore course mein yahi reference hai.
Reviewed English translation: Take 5–7 clear phone photos from different angles in daylight, with flash off. In Google Flow choose New project → Image → Nano Banana Pro. Upload all photos as references and run the Product Sheet template. Review, regenerate if needed, and save the best sheet for later shots.

[S4] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Lesson 02 — Phone Photo Se Studio Photo (course-material) [Lesson 02; lesson_2]
Phone Photo Se Studio Photo Angle photos → Product Sheet → white studio, lifestyle, dark premium

[S5] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Product photos (course-material) [Lesson 02; lesson_2]
• Reference mein sirf product sheet. • Prompt ki pehli line: product bilkul waisa hi. • Phir scene: jagah, 2–3 cheezein, roshni, angle. Sajawat peeche, product aage.
Reviewed English translation: Use only the product sheet as reference. Start the prompt by keeping the product unchanged, then describe the place, 2–3 objects, lighting and angle. Keep decoration behind and the product in front.

[S6] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Har photo mein product thoda alag (course-material) [Lesson 02; lesson_2]
Har photo mein product thoda alag Sheet ke bina bana rahe ho. Pehle product sheet banao, phir har dikh raha photo usi se. (L02, L08)
Reviewed English translation: First make a product sheet, then use the same sheet as the reference for every new product image.

Label ke akshar / keys ke letters Product sheet reference lagao, pehli line "keep exactly the same, badal gaye same text and logo". Chhota text AI ki limitation hai — 2–3 versions banao, best chuno. (L02)
Reviewed English translation: Use the product sheet reference and start with “keep exactly the same, same text and logo”. Small text is an AI limitation. Generate 2–3 versions and choose the clearest; perfect lettering is not guaranteed.

[S2] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Video mein letters blur (course-material) [Lesson 06; lesson_6]
Video mein letters blur Movement mein chhota text bigad sakta hai. Dheema movement, 2–3 baar banao. (L06)
Reviewed English translation: Small text can blur during movement: this is an AI limitation. Use one slow movement, generate 2–3 versions and choose the clearest. A perfect result is not guaranteed.

[S3] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Product sheet banana (course-material) [Lesson 02; lesson_2]
• Phone se product ki 5–7 photos, alag angles, din ki roshni, flash off, details saaf. • Google Flow → New project → Image → Nano Banana Pro. • Saari photos upload/reference mein lagao → product sheet prompt chalao. • Sheet achhi na aaye toh dobara generate karo. Achhi sheet ko save rakho — poore course mein yahi reference hai.
Reviewed English translation: Take 5–7 clear phone photos from different angles in daylight, with flash off. In Google Flow choose New project → Image → Nano Banana Pro. Upload all photos as references and run the Product Sheet template. Review, regenerate if needed, and save the best sheet for later shots.

[S4] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Lesson 02 — Phone Photo Se Studio Photo (course-material) [Lesson 02; lesson_2]
Phone Photo Se Studio Photo Angle photos → Product Sheet → white studio, lifestyle, dark premium

[S5] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Product photos (course-material) [Lesson 02; lesson_2]
• Reference mein sirf product sheet. • Prompt ki pehli line: product bilkul waisa hi. • Phir scene: jagah, 2–3 cheezein, roshni, angle. Sajawat peeche, product aage.
Reviewed English translation: Use only the product sheet as reference. Start the prompt by keeping the product unchanged, then describe the place, 2–3 objects, lighting and angle. Keep decoration behind and the product in front.

[S6] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Har photo mein product thoda alag (course-material) [Lesson 02; lesson_2]
Har photo mein product thoda alag Sheet ke bina bana rahe ho. Pehle product sheet banao, phir har dikh raha photo usi se. (L02, L08)
Reviewed English translation: First make a product sheet, then use the same sheet as the reference for every new product image.
